title: GPCRome basal cAMP screen: processing, scoring and figure code
description:
Code, processed data and figures for the basal cAMP GPCRome screen in Howard et al. 2026 — a pooled measurement of ligand-independent (basal) Gs/cAMP signalling across 946 barcoded human GPCR constructs in a HEK293T CRE–eGFP reporter line.

The repository is scoped to Figure 1, Supplemental Figures 1 and 2, and Supplemental Table 1 of the manuscript: the barcode-counting pipeline, the weighted-mean-bin scoring, the annotation tables those figures read, and the scripts that drew the panels. The six derived tables in data/processed/ regenerate byte-identically from the per-barcode counts in data/counts/ and the reference data shipped alongside them by running run_all.sh.

Third-party reference data redistributed under data/external/ (Tedman et al. 2026, Nature Communications, DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-76564-7; GproteinDb/GPCRdb G-protein coupling table) is not covered by this record's licence and keeps its own licence and attribution, as documented in data/external/README.md.

Code in pipeline/ and scripts/ is MIT (LICENSE); the data, figures, tables and documentation are CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA). Third-party reference data under data/external/ keeps its own licence.
